gloss: Western tableware; Western-style dishes and utensils

definitions.gloss: Western tableware; Western-style dishes and utensils
definitions.explanation: Tableware designed in Western style, including plates, knives, forks, spoons, and glasses, as distinct from traditional Japanese tableware.

examples.japanese: {洋食器|ようしょっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}えた→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
examples.english: I got a set of Western tableware.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}{祝|いわ}い→結婚祝い：19656_kekkoniwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{洋食器|ようしょっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a set of Western tableware as a wedding gift.

examples.english: This store carries both Japanese and Western tableware, so you can choose to match your dining style.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) and ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧ (tableware). In Japan, both Western and Japanese tableware are commonly used in homes. {洋食器|ようしょっき} typically refers to flat plates, soup bowls, knives, forks, spoons, wine glasses, and similar items.

Western tableware sets are popular wedding gifts in Japan. Well-known brands include both imported European makers and Japanese manufacturers like Noritake.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋食器|ようしょっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: Western tableware set
- {洋食器|ようしょっき}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: Western tableware section (in a department store)
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{洋食器|ようしょっき}: fine Western tableware

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和食器|わしょっき}→和食器：26107_washokki⟧: Japanese tableware — bowls, chopsticks, small plates, and other traditional items
- ⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧: tableware, dishes — the general term covering all types
